name: Debian-family Live recovery and administration tools
description: Selectable packages installed into supported Debian-family Live root filesystems so storage recovery, firmware maintenance, networking, diagnostics, and routine administration do not depend on a boot-time package installation.

package_groups.title: Filesystem and partitioning tools
package_groups.description: Core disk layout and ext, FAT, exFAT, and NTFS creation, checking, and repair utilities.

package_groups.title: NVMe tools
package_groups.description: Inspect, diagnose, format, sanitize, and manage NVMe devices with nvme-cli.

package_groups.title: F2FS tools
package_groups.description: Create, inspect, resize, and repair F2FS filesystems.

package_groups.title: Btrfs tools
package_groups.description: Create, inspect, scrub, balance, rescue, and repair Btrfs filesystems.

package_groups.title: XFS tools
package_groups.description: Create, inspect, grow, copy, and repair XFS filesystems.

package_groups.title: LVM, RAID, and encryption
package_groups.description: Manage LVM volumes, Linux MD RAID arrays, and LUKS-encrypted storage.

package_groups.title: Storage diagnostics
package_groups.description: Inspect SMART, ATA, SCSI, and block-device health and capabilities.

package_groups.title: Data recovery and imaging
package_groups.description: Recover partitions and files, clone filesystems, rescue damaged media, and handle SquashFS images.

package_groups.title: Network configuration tools
package_groups.description: Configure wired and wireless links, addresses, routes, DNS, bridges, and radio state.

package_groups.title: Nmap network scanner
package_groups.description: Discover hosts, services, versions, and common network exposure with nmap.

package_groups.title: Network diagnostics and capture
package_groups.description: Capture traffic, test throughput, relay sockets, and troubleshoot TCP and UDP services.

package_groups.title: Remote access and transfer
package_groups.description: Retrieve files and work with remote systems through HTTP, SSH, rsync, and related protocols.

package_groups.title: Firewall tools
package_groups.description: Inspect and repair nftables and iptables firewall policies.

package_groups.title: Firmware and hardware inventory
package_groups.description: Inventory firmware, PCI, USB, DMI, and general hardware information.

package_groups.title: Firmware update tools
package_groups.description: Apply LVFS-supported updates, inspect Secure Boot state, manage EFI boot entries, and service flash devices.

package_groups.title: Firmware and SPI programmer tools
package_groups.description: Read, verify, erase, and write firmware with flashrom CH341A-compatible SPI programmers, AVR programmers, USB DFU, JTAG/SWD, and I2C tools.

package_groups.title: Hardware stress and diagnostics
package_groups.description: Read sensors and exercise memory, CPU, I/O, and other hardware for troubleshooting.

package_groups.title: Network and enterprise storage
package_groups.description: Access NFS and SMB shares and inspect iSCSI and multipath storage.

package_groups.title: System administration tools
package_groups.description: Shell, editor, process, tracing, inventory, certificate, access-control, and monitoring utilities.

package_groups.title: Compression tools
package_groups.description: Work with xz, zstd, and lz4 compressed images, archives, kernels, and logs.

notes: The interactive application selects package groups only for supported Live or Hybrid media; Netinst and Netboot plans never receive this payload.
The remaster path installs with --no-install-recommends and cleans downloaded package archives before repacking the squashfs.
Package installation uses valid on-medium APT metadata when available and otherwise requires working configured network repositories during USB creation.
CH341A SPI flashing is provided by flashrom's ch341a_spi programmer backend and intentionally retains flashrom's root-access requirement.
Tails is intentionally excluded because modifying its root filesystem would violate its upstream image integrity and security model.
